title: Super Mario World - Return to Y.O.S.H.I ~ Here We Go (Remix)
description:
Did an special arrangement of Here We Go from Super Mario World for my Love-Colored MASTER SPARC700 Winter C3 2023 Album.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. F Major (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. F# Major (Demo's Journey Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Voice Clip, but at the cost of SMW-Compatibility
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Voice Clip [turned on default]
